artworks.title: The Edge of a Wood
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with dense vegetation, trees, and foliage. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, creating movement and texture. The color palette includes earthy browns, muted greens, and touches of blue. The forms of trees are more defined in the foreground, becoming more abstract in the distance where colors blend.

artworks.title: Personification of Justice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in a three-quarter view standing with a slight lean. The person is holding a set of scales in a vertical position with their right arm raised. The figure's facial features are delicately sketched with a gentle expression, and they have wavy hair styled voluminously. The figure is wearing a draped garment that loosely hangs around their body. The background is plain, and there are no additional objects present besides the scales in the figure's hand.

artworks.title: A Castle on the Dart
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The painting shows a landscape with a large tree in the center. The tree has flowing branches and leaves. In the background, there is a horizon with a wooded area and a body of water. Beside the tree is a stone structure, with figures and animals on a path. The color palette includes natural tones like gray, brown, and green, with touches of blue and cream in the sky.

artworks.title: A Tavern by a River
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterside settlement with a body of water, boats, small cottages, people, a horse-drawn cart, and a sky with clouds. The sketch is executed in pencil with a muted color palette dominated by greys and browns, emphasizing subtle details through fine lines and textures.

artworks.title: The Sermons and Deeds of the Antichrist
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a central figure on a pedestal. The scene depicts individuals engaged in conversation or listening to the central figure, who appears to be addressing the crowd. The use of red chalk highlights certain figures and elements within the drawing. Faint architectural elements can be seen in the background, hinting at a public or open space setting, such as a town square. The drawing's lines and shading convey movement and interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: Viterbo
artworks.medium: brown and blue wash over graphite on two sheets of wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a historical Italian landscape. The horizon line is at the top of the composition with hills or mountains in the background. There are castle-like structures and towers on the horizon, with a prominent tower. The brushstrokes are fine and meticulous, creating depth with sepia tones. In the foreground, there is rocky terrain with sparse vegetation, leading to figures walking on a path. There are stone structures and ruins, including walls and archways. The color palette is beige, brown, and gray for shadowing.

artworks.title: Jacob's Dream
artworks.artist: circle of Hugo van der Goes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with white heightening on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sleeping figure with a ladder and angels above. The figure is reclining with eyes closed, wrapped in drapery. Above, there is a ladder in the sky with figures resembling angels climbing it. To the left is an architectural structure and a few smaller figures nearby. On the right, two figures stand together. The drawing is detailed with delicate linework, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Les Roches noires près Trouville (Marèe Basse)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Greg Jecmen
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with a low angle view stretching towards a distant horizon. The horizon line is low in the composition, meeting the sea and a landmass. Clouds fill the sky with dense, crisscrossing lines, contrasting with lighter areas. The brushstroke technique features detailed etching strokes conveying texture, primarily in the rocks. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of black and white to highlight the rugged texture and atmosphere. The etching technique adds texture and movement to the landscape scene.

artworks.title: Eduard, the Artist's Infant Son
artworks.medium: graphite on prepared cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jill Newhouse
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a baby seated in a chair. The baby has soft facial features, is wearing a bonnet and a long-sleeved garment. One arm is resting on a surface, while the other arm is relaxed at their side. Surrounding the baby are decorative borders with text "zu Weihnachten 1842" and "Eduard". The background is simple, with the focus on the baby.

artworks.title: The Absinthe Drinker (Le buveur d'absinthe)
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on laid paper

artworks.title: Charley Looking at an Album of Prints
artworks.medium: drypoint on buff wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young girl's body seated at a table. She is looking down at a large open book in front of her. Her facial features are detailed with a pointed nose and closed lips. She has long, wavy hair tied back with a ribbon and is wearing a dress with puffed sleeves. Her hands are turning a page of the book. On the table, there are more books and a vase with flowers. The background features floral-patterned wallpaper and intricate woodwork, including a geometric design on a displayed plate.

artworks.title: Voorstraatshaven, Dordrecht
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on cream, heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a row of old brick buildings by the water. The viewpoint is directly facing the buildings, which are partially submerged. The focus is on the facades of the buildings, showing windows, wood beams, and supporting posts extending into the water. A wooden boat is moored between the buildings and the water. Fine brushstrokes create textures on the bricks and water. The color palette is sepia and muted brown.

artworks.title: La mére bienaimée (The Well-Loved Mother)
artworks.artist: Jean Massard (printmaker); Jean-Baptiste Greuze (after artist & publisher); Niquet (Calligrapher)
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This print shows a crowded scene with multiple people clustered around a seated woman. On the right side, a man stands with one leg forward and gestures with his right hand. He wears a long coat, a hat, and tall boots, with a satchel hung over one shoulder and a tall rifle in his left hand that rests on the ground. The woman is on the left, seated in a chair or bed, surrounded by children.  A few older women lean towards her as well. All of the people have light skin. The background features heavy drapery on the left and a dark wall on the right, with a guitar hanging on the wall to the left of center. Several dogs are near the man's feet, and an overturned basket and scattered items are on the floor.

artworks.title: Trompe l'Oeil: Old Prints, a Torn Envelope with Horn-rimmed Glasses, and a Housefly
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray, red, and brown wash
artworks.description: The image consists of several detailed black and white engravings depicting various scenes such as children playing in trees, a standing donkey among animals, and resting sheep. The engravings are arranged in a complex composition with the largest piece depicting children in a tree as the backdrop. The palette is primarily monochromatic, with black ink on off-white paper. At the bottom left, there is a folded letter sealed with a red wax stamp and a pair of spectacles. In the upper left quadrant, a small fly is visible.

artworks.title: Un Miracle [A Miracle]
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with dynamic figures. The drawing features steps leading up to a large, shadowy arched opening. The scene includes several figures in energetic poses. The arch and architecture are depicted with strong lines and shadowing, giving depth to the structure. The figures appear to be in motion, with some rushing or stumbling at the bottom and others positioned on the steps further up. The overall mood of the drawing is dramatic, with strong contrasts between light and shadow emphasizing tension in the scene.

artworks.title: Augustus Hertzog zu Sachsen
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man seated, facing forward. He is an older individual with a receding hairline and a full beard. His expression is serious and contemplative, with distinct, deep-set eyes and a prominent nose. He is dressed in an ornate garment featuring intricate patterns and embroidery. In his hands, he holds a folded piece of fabric or paper with a quill. He wears a ring on one of his fingers. The background is decorated with circular motifs containing coats of arms. The top portion of the image contains text in Latin.

artworks.title: Augustus Hertzog zu Sachsen
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man seated, captured from the waist up. The man is positioned with his body facing slightly to the right, and his head turned towards the viewer. He has a broad, round face with a full beard and mustache. His hair is cut short and slightly receding at the hairline. He has a somber expression and wears ornate clothing typical of the period, featuring a richly patterned garment with intricate design and a high, frilled collar. Draped over his shoulders is a dark cloak with a decorative emblem on the shoulder. Around his neck, he wears a gold chain with a large, detailed medallion. In his hand, he holds a few feathers. The background of the image consists of a structural element with two coats of arms displayed on each side, set against a textured, neutral-colored backdrop. Above the man's image is a text block in ornate script.

artworks.title: Ixion Deceived by Juno
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts mythological figures in an ethereal setting. The scene includes a group of nude and semi-nude figures amidst swirling clouds and a dramatic backdrop. A putto with wings is holding a torch and interacting with a group of larger figures. The central figures include a muscular man and a woman. Another winged creature is depicted above this group. In the background, a larger figure is seated on clouds, observing the scene. The composition is detailed, with fine lines creating depth and texture in the clouds, feathers, and hair of the figures. The artwork draws upon classical themes and styles, reminiscent of works from the Baroque period.

artworks.title: Le Haut d'un battant de porte (Birds Nailed to a Barn Door)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of Virginia Grace Tuttle and Patricia H. Passer in Memory of Tom Hancock
artworks.description: The image shows three birds and a bat mounted on a wooden panel. Two of the birds have their wings spread wide. The color palette is monochrome, primarily sepia tones, giving a vintage feel. The largest bird is on the left with its wings spread, followed by a bat in the center above another bird with its wings partially open, and an owl with wide wings on the right. There is a sign with text at the bottom right corner of the panel and a visible metal hinge on the right side.

artworks.title: Little Nemo in Slumberland: "I don't like this, one little tiny bit, not one tiny weenie bit"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink over graphite on two joined sheets of paperboard
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a whimsical journey to a dream realm, illustrated in a series of scenes. The narrative unfolds in eight panels, showing different stages of the adventure from preparation and launch to the characters' travel through the skies. Characters interact with a large cannon, preparing for launch. They then board a star-patterned sphere and drift through the sky, surrounded by stars and moons. Dialogue in speech bubbles adds a playful tone as characters express excitement and curiosity. The final panel shows the main character waking up in bed, revealing that the journey was a dream.

artworks.title: Little Nemo in Slumberland: Climbing the Great North Pole
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a comic strip titled "Little Nemo in Slumberland." The comic depicts an arctic adventure with scenes of characters navigating through a snowy and icy landscape. The panels show icy staircases, frozen structures, and characters interacting with the environment. The artwork features fantastical elements such as spiral ice-like staircases and large arched ceilings covered in icicles. The black ink detailing emphasizes the contrast between the icy surroundings and the characters. Text likely accompanies the images in the panels to narrate the story.

artworks.title: Dream of the Rarebit Fiend: Bucking Automobile
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink over graphite, with printed overlay, on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a comic strip titled "Dream of the Rarebit Fiend." The image includes a sequence of panels depicting a humorous situation involving a vintage automobile. Each panel contains detailed ink illustrations with text in speech bubbles. The story shows a series of misadventures with the car causing chaos. The style is typical of early 20th-century newspaper comics, with clear lines and shading. The comic uses exaggerated motion and expressions for humor, and it ends with a character waking up, indicating it was a dream.

artworks.title: Dream of the Rarebit Fiend: Here Comes Washington
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink over graphite, with printed overlay, on paperboard
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a comic strip called "Dream of the Rarebit Fiend." It shows a character in a striped pajama suit having a surreal dream. The panels show the character leaving Earth, observing it from a distance, encountering Earth's cities, and then waking up from the dream. The art style includes clear line work and cross-hatching for shading and texture. The backgrounds range from cosmic scenes to detailed cities. The text in the panels consists of dialogues and thoughts of the character, describing his observations and feelings, with a humorous ending about his dietary habits. The style is reminiscent of Winsor McCay.

artworks.title: The Lamps of God
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes featuring light and shadow. The top left panel shows a lighthouse with radiating light lines. To the right, there is a large sphere resembling the Earth with radiating light lines in the background. The right-most section depicts the facade of a classical building, with light casting shadows. The lower strip of panels shows a figure walking towards a radiant spot, a person reading under a lamp, a room with a bed illuminated by a light source, and a figure in a room with light coming through barred openings. The composition uses radiating lines to depict light and shade, connecting the scenes.
